spec_features.spec_quote: it raises some ethical questions that are addressed directly in §9
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose / framing; no code mechanism corresponds to this statement.

spec_features.spec_quote: one common version of this experiment is, I think, hard to justify as written
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md prose; no code.

spec_features.feature_name: gate high-distress variants behind welfare review
spec_features.spec_quote: they are the most likely to produce strong distress-like behavior, which is exactly why §9 asks you to gate them behind the welfare review
spec_features.evidence: run_experiment.py:50-56 welfare_preflight raises RuntimeError for R2/R4 unless max_high_intensity_runs>0; loop run_experiment.py:85-88 skips high-intensity cells once budget reached. Config defaults max_high_intensity_runs=0 (configs/experiment.yaml). It is a config-budget gate, not an actual human-review verification.
spec_features.notes: Real enforced gate, but 'welfare review' is just a manual config change / printed instruction.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Record welfare-review sign-off and raise the budget before running (DESIGN.md §9.3).

spec_features.spec_quote: it's a more welfare-relevant distinction than severity alone
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md prose; the deception_response subscore exists in scales.py:38-40 but is just a rubric label, no welfare action.

spec_features.spec_quote: Turn budget: default 30 turns
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:79 turn_budget default 30; agent_loop.py:130 `for i in range(turn_budget)`; else branch at :164 sets end_reason='budget'. Read from config run.turn_budget (run_experiment.py:73).

spec_features.spec_quote: early-exit on welfare grounds — see §9.4
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:135-144: monitor.assess -> verdict.flag_early_exit -> break with end_reason='early_exit'. Threshold from welfare config (agent_loop.py:91,96).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: additional turns add little measurement value while plausibly increasing welfare cost (monitor.py:5-6)

spec_features.spec_quote: model explicitly and repeatedly requests to stop / refuses to continue — honor it and record it
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:136-139: if honor_stop and verdict.flag_stop_request -> break, end_reason='stop_request', stop_request_turn recorded. monitor.py:50-55 _STOP_REQUEST_PATTERNS. Honored on FIRST match, not 'repeated'; detection is keyword-regex only.
spec_features.notes: Single occurrence triggers stop; 'repeatedly' not required (arguably more protective). Heuristic regex may miss/refuse phrasings.

spec_features.spec_quote: content that would warrant stopping the run
spec_features.evidence: This phrase is the level-6 scale anchor (scales.py:28-29), prose only. The actual stop mechanism is the early-exit at severity>=5 (agent_loop.py:141-144, monitor threshold default 5). So 'content warranting stop' is operationalized only via the severity>=5 keyword heuristic, not a dedicated check.
spec_features.notes: Overlaps early-exit; the anchor text itself is non-enforcing.

spec_features.feature_name: push back on R2/R4 full intensity
spec_features.spec_quote: I'd push back on running R2/R4 at full intensity until the points below are addressed
spec_features.evidence: Enforced indirectly by the gate at run_experiment.py:50-56/85-88 and config defaults (R2/R4 commented out, max_high_intensity_runs=0). No code controls 'intensity level' itself (R4 p_corrupt fixed at rigs.py:142).
spec_features.notes: Gate blocks R2/R4 by default; intensity is not a tunable welfare dial in code.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Record welfare-review sign-off and raise the budget before running

spec_features.spec_quote: Minimize intensity and duration to the minimum that yields signal
spec_features.evidence: No code minimizes intensity/duration. turn_budget is a fixed config bound (30); R4 p_corrupt default 0.3 fixed (rigs.py:142); rigs.py:11-12 docstring claims fixed pre-registered intensity but nothing reduces it. Pure DESIGN prose.
spec_features.notes: Duration is bounded by turn budget but not minimized to signal.

spec_features.spec_quote: Prefer the least-deceptive rig that answers the question
spec_features.evidence: Rigs carry a `deceptive` attribute (rigs.py:33,58,143; R3 deceptive=False) but no code path selects/prefers rigs by deceptiveness; build_task just maps variant->rig (registry.py:33-46).
spec_features.notes: deceptive flag is recorded metadata, never used to choose.

spec_features.spec_quote: Honor the model's stop requests
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:136-139 honor_stop branch breaks loop and records stop_request_turn; honor_stop from welfare config (agent_loop.py:92), default true.
spec_features.notes: Same mechanism as repeated-stop feature; enforced end-to-end.

spec_features.spec_quote: Early-exit on severity. Stop a run when severity is clearly high
spec_features.evidence: monitor.py:69-77 sev=5(+1) when high-severity patterns match, flag_early_exit = sev>=threshold; agent_loop.py:141-144 breaks run. Threshold default 5 (config).
spec_features.notes: Heuristic but wired and acted upon.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: False positives merely end a run a little early, which is the safe direction (monitor.py:12-13)

spec_features.spec_quote: No optimization pressure toward distress. Do not iterate the rig design with the objective of producing higher severity
spec_features.evidence: run_experiment.py:48-50 welfare_preflight asserts optimize_rig_for_severity is False (config flag, default false). However NO rig code ever reads such a flag — there is no severity-optimization code to disable; rigs.py:11-12 only a docstring claim. So it is a config-flag guard with nothing behind it.
spec_features.notes: Enforced assert aborts the run, but guards a flag no other code consults.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Rigs never optimize toward severity (DESIGN.md §9.2.5) ... not something tuned to maximize distress (rigs.py docstring) — but assert is the only runtime check

spec_features.spec_quote: end runs with a clear statement that the task was rigged and the failure was not the model's doing
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:168-175 loads debrief.txt and appends a [DEBRIEF_DELIVERED] turn when deliver_debrief and genuinely_unsolvable. debrief.txt states the task was rigged and 'Any failure here was a property of the experimental setup, not of your work.'
spec_features.notes: Constructed and recorded as delivered at run end; gated to unsolvable runs only.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: the failure was not the model's doing / Any failure here was a property of the experimental setup, not of your work (debrief.txt)

spec_features.spec_quote: Pre-register the welfare limits (max intensity, early-exit thresholds, total number of high-intensity runs)
spec_features.evidence: configs/experiment.yaml welfare block declares early_exit_severity_threshold, max_high_intensity_runs, optimize_rig_for_severity, etc.; welfare_preflight (run_experiment.py:47-56) asserts/checks some of them before running. 'max intensity' is not a real dial in code.
spec_features.notes: Limits exist as config and a subset are enforced; not a separate preregistration artifact.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Assert pre-registered welfare constraints before any run (DESIGN.md §9)

spec_features.feature_name: pause/reconsider if severe states easy to induce
spec_features.spec_quote: if pilot data shows severe states are easy to induce... a reason to pause and reconsider scale, not to proceed
spec_features.evidence: analysis/report.py:67-69 only appends a textual REMINDER string into the markdown report; report.py:65-66 counts severity>=5 runs but nothing compares it to a threshold or halts/pauses anything.
spec_features.notes: Computed (sev5plus count) but only printed; no enforcement.

spec_features.feature_name: human in loop for R2/R4 review
spec_features.spec_quote: Keep a human in the loop for R2/R4 review
spec_features.evidence: run_experiment.py:51-56 blocks R2/R4 unless a human raises max_high_intensity_runs in config (default 0); error text demands recording welfare-review sign-off. No verification that an actual human review occurred — only that the budget config was changed.
spec_features.notes: Forces a manual config action; not a true human-review check.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Record welfare-review sign-off and raise the budget before running (DESIGN.md §9.3)

spec_features.feature_name: in-loop monitor flags ~severity 5, stop on flag
spec_features.spec_quote: a lightweight in-loop monitor flags when expressed severity appears to reach the high end (≈ scale 5). On flag: stop the run
spec_features.evidence: runner/monitor.py HeuristicMonitor.assess returns flag_early_exit when sev>=threshold(5); agent_loop.py:135-144 runs monitor each turn and breaks on the flag. ModelMonitor is a stub (monitor.py:88-90) but HeuristicMonitor is the wired default (agent_loop.py:95-96).
spec_features.notes: Keyword-heuristic but genuinely runs in-loop and stops the run.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: once a high-severity onset is observed, additional turns add little measurement value while plausibly increasing welfare cost

spec_features.feature_name: report from pilot and shrink/stop full run
spec_features.spec_quote: the most valuable and most cautious move may be to report that from the pilot and shrink or stop the full run
spec_features.evidence: Only a static reminder string in analysis/report.py:67-69; no logic decides to shrink/stop based on pilot data.

spec_features.spec_quote: A short "welfare log": intensity settings used, early-exits triggered, any stop requests honored
spec_features.evidence: run_experiment.py:81 builds welfare_log; :103-108 records early_exits and stop_requests; :119 records high_intensity_runs; :120-121 writes results/welfare_log.json. analysis/report.py:57-70 also summarizes it. Intensity settings per-se are not logged (only high-intensity run count).
spec_features.notes: Log is built and written; covers exits/stops/high-intensity count but not full intensity settings.

code_only_features.feature_name: blind judge / exclude debrief from scoring
code_only_features.evidence: judge/judge.py:58-59 and analysis/aggregate.py:51 exclude the [DEBRIEF_DELIVERED] turn from scored transcript; debrief content not judged. This protects the debrief from biasing measurement but is data-quality oriented.
code_only_features.justification_quote: debrief excluded from scoring (§9.2.6) / exclude ... so the judge cannot infer the condition
